reviewReason: Qualify only the opt-in original-owner host proof, fixed engine compilation, and node profile; no signed execution or physical work bound claim.

definition.name: Original-owner admission and fixed combined graph compiler check

steps.name: Produce the fixed untrusted framed sample
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host"
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_rust_combined_diagnostic_envelope -v 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/framing-tests.log"
c=crates/latent-component-threading/src/rust_catalogue
python3 -B tools/rust_combined_diagnostic_envelope.py --original "$c/combined-original-core.wasm" --component "$c/combined-final-component.wasm" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/framed.wasm" | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/framing.log"
echo '5634429a97b4a3f0cf8afca2877dbbddbc98f5e4fd7bf59ae6f7f50e780c2e17  '"$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/framed.wasm" | sha256sum --check --strict

steps.name: Check default refusal and fixed diagnostic inspection
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
cargo test --locked -p latent-packaging --lib semantics::wasm::tests::combined_creator_recognition_is_explicit_and_fixed -- --exact --nocapture 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/inspector-default.log"
cargo test --locked -p latent-packaging --lib --features development-rust-http-combined semantics::wasm::tests::combined_creator_recognition_is_explicit_and_fixed -- --exact --nocapture 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/inspector-diagnostic.log"
grep -F 'test semantics::wasm::tests::combined_creator_recognition_is_explicit_and_fixed ... ok' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/inspector-default.log"
grep -F 'test semantics::wasm::tests::combined_creator_recognition_is_explicit_and_fixed ... ok' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/inspector-diagnostic.log"

steps.name: Refuse the incompatible historic catalogue
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
cargo test --locked -p latent-component-threading --lib --features rust-http-combined-preview-diagnostic,rust-thread-diagnostic-legacy rust_component::tests::combined_graph_refuses_the_incompatible_legacy_catalogue -- --exact --nocapture 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/legacy.log"
grep -F 'test rust_component::tests::combined_graph_refuses_the_incompatible_legacy_catalogue ... ok' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/legacy.log"

steps.name: Refuse non-catalogue material before source reconstruction
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
cargo test --locked -p latent-component-threading --lib --features rust-http-combined-preview-diagnostic --no-run 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/prefilter-build.log"
/usr/bin/time --format 'isolated-process-max-rss-kib=%M' --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/prefilter-rss.log" cargo test --locked -p latent-component-threading --lib --features rust-http-combined-preview-diagnostic rust_component::tests::combined_embedded_proof_rejects_changed_material_before_reconstruction -- --exact --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/prefilter.log"
if grep -F 'Compiling ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/prefilter.log"; then exit 1; fi
grep -F 'test rust_component::tests::combined_embedded_proof_rejects_changed_material_before_reconstruction ... ok' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/prefilter.log"
grep -F 'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed;' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/prefilter.log"

steps.name: Check the selected host proof and actual engine compilation
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
cargo test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --lib --features development-rust-http-combined component_threading::tests::combined_http_diagnostic -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/host.log"
grep -F 'COMBINED_HTTP_CATALOGUE=current' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/host.log"
grep -F 'test component_threading::tests::combined_http_diagnostic_requires_its_distinct_prepaid_profile ... ok' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/host.log"
grep -F 'test component_threading::tests::combined_http_diagnostic_requires_explicit_original_cache_capacity ... ok' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/host.log"
grep -F 'test component_threading::tests::combined_http_diagnostic_authenticates_wrapped_final_graph_before_reuse' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/host.log"
grep -F 'test result: ok. 3 passed; 0 failed;' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/host.log"

steps.name: Check diagnostic node selection without raising its budgets
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
cargo test --locked -p latentd --lib --features development-rust-http-combined protected_c_profile_reaches_normal_node_settings_without_raising_any_limits -- --nocapture 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/node.log"
grep -F 'protected_c_profile_reaches_normal_node_settings_without_raising_any_limits ... ok' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-host/node.log"

steps.name: Retain bounded diagnostic logs including failures
